cardBody: Five steps through assigning, reviewing, returning, how trust changes, and the flow back into the knowledge base.
escHint: Press Esc to end it at any time.
todayBody: Work handed in by AI employees waits here for your review; items with failing checks come first.
reviewBody: The employee marks the points to check, plus automated checks; you decide to accept or return.
returnBody: When you return work, pick one of three reasons: "It is wrong" sends this kind of work back to "Review every item"; the other two do not affect trust.
trustBody: Trust grows with reviews; reviewing key points needs your consent and you can take it back at any time.
flowbackBody: Accepted knowledge base entries go into the knowledge base and the graph, marked with where they came from.
